terms.gloss: be on good terms, get on
terms.grammar: verb, first conjugation, intransitive: cum aliquō
evidence: Ter. Ph. 2.3.86: concordāre cum aliquō (Lewis & Short)

terms.gloss: agree, get on with each other
terms.grammar: congruō, third conjugation, with inter sē
evidence: Plaut. Curc. 2.2.14: illī inter sē congruunt concorditer (Lewis & Short), s.v. congruō

sources: Lewis & Short: concordo · Lewis & Short: congruo · Lewis & Short: concorditer
